title: session-load's live mode attributes the host's running Claude sessions' process trees to process classes
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --live samples for --window seconds the process trees of the running Claude Code sessions in this clone (interactive and headless told apart, as kbmon's sessions panel does) or of the roots --live-pids names, and writes arm live rows per process class (case 'live <class>', 'all' for their sum: cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb, spawns_per_min); its per-sample snapshot goes under _cache/ only, its path printed

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
child = 'import time; t = time.time()\nwhile time.time() - t < 6: pass'
parent = ('import subprocess, sys\n'
          'c = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", ' + repr(child) + ', "kbmon.py", "--once"])\n'
          'import time; time.sleep(20); c.kill()')
root = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', parent])
try:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--live', '--live-pids', str(root.pid),
                        '--window', '5', '--out', out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
finally:
    root.kill()
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --live exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
val = {(r['case'], r['metric']): float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load' and r['arm'] == 'live'}
assert val.get(('live kbmon', 'cpu_s'), 0) > 1, ('the busy kbmon-named child is not attributed', val.get(('live kbmon', 'cpu_s')))
assert ('live all', 'rss_peak_mb') in val, 'no live all rss_peak_mb row'
snap = [ln for ln in p.stdout.splitlines() if 'snapshot' in ln]
assert snap and all('_cache/' in ln for ln in snap), ('the snapshot is not written under _cache/', snap)

clauses.clause: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --live samples for --window seconds the process trees of the running Claude Code sessions in this clone (interactive and headless told apart, as kbmon's sessions panel does) or of the roots --live-pids names
writes arm live rows per process class (case 'live <class>', 'all' for their sum: cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb, spawns_per_min)
its per-sample snapshot goes under _cache/ only, its path printed

notes: Reads the live sessions through the in-process reader ST-bngriclp adds to _tools/mon_sessions.py (pid, session id, checkout, role, item), agreed with that epic's session through coord; it adds no second reader. A kbtail follower shows as its own process class. mon_sessions.live_sessions(root) (landed with ST-bngriclp) gives a worker's item as the raw suffix of its work/ branch when that is no backlog item id: keep only item ids or pass the text through redact.redact, as kbtail does since BG-lagjhkzn. Nothing it writes holds a session's prompt or a path outside the clone; the review reads the rows and snapshot it writes for that.
